entries.en: The children watched wonderingly as the huge paper lantern rose into the sky.
entries.zh: 孩子们惊讶地看着那盏巨大的纸灯笼升上天空。

entries.en: The novel's second plotline follows two friends who stop writing to each other.
entries.zh: 小说的第二条情节主线讲述两个不再互相通信的朋友的故事。

entries.en: He leaned the pickaxe against a rock and wiped his hands.
entries.zh: 他把镐靠在石头上，然后擦了擦手。

entries.en: As a teetotaller, she chose sparkling water instead of wine.
entries.zh: 作为一位完全不饮酒的人，她选了气泡水而不是葡萄酒。

entries.en: The switcher moved three empty wagons to another track.
entries.zh: 调车机车把三节空货车移到了另一条轨道上。

entries.en: The flat was clean but too poky for a family of five.
entries.zh: 这套公寓很干净，但对五口之家来说太狭小了。

entries.en: A wormlike robot wriggled through the narrow transparent tube.
entries.zh: 一个像虫子一样的机器人在狭窄的透明管子里蠕动前行。

entries.en: The shop still sells recordable CDs for making music compilations.
entries.zh: 这家商店仍然出售可录音光盘，用来制作音乐合辑。

entries.en: Investigators described the small plane's crash as survivable.
entries.zh: 调查人员称，这起小型飞机坠毁事故中有生还的可能。

entries.en: The presenter moved slickly from the live demonstration to the questions.
entries.zh: 主持人熟练地从现场演示转入问答环节。

entries.en: Please unlatch the wooden gate before you carry the boxes through.
entries.zh: 在把箱子搬过去之前，请先拉开木门的门闩。

entries.en: The shrimper repaired his net while the tide was low.
entries.zh: 潮水较低时，这名捕虾人修补了自己的渔网。

entries.en: The controller sends each instruction to the appropriate processing subunit.
entries.zh: 控制器把每条指令发送到相应的处理子单元。

entries.en: She rented a telephoto lens to photograph the birds without approaching them.
entries.zh: 她租了一个远摄镜头，以便不靠近鸟儿就能给它们拍照。

entries.en: I liked the tactility of the unglazed ceramic bowl.
entries.zh: 我喜欢那只未上釉陶碗的触感。

entries.en: The spunky little dog was still eager to play after the long walk.
entries.zh: 那只精力充沛的小狗走了很长一段路后仍然想玩。

entries.en: The designer will restyle the lobby without changing its original staircase.
entries.zh: 设计师将改变大厅的风格，但不会改动原来的楼梯。

entries.en: Nobody wanted to be a spoilsport, so we all joined the game.
entries.zh: 谁也不想成为扫兴的人，所以我们都参加了游戏。

entries.en: The ring remained unredeemed in the pawnshop for months.
entries.zh: 那枚戒指在当铺里放了好几个月，一直没有被赎回。

entries.en: The room had an unpleasing smell of damp cloth and stale air.
entries.zh: 房间里有一股令人不愉快的湿布和浑浊空气的气味。

entries.en: I become scatterbrained when I try to do several tasks at once.
entries.zh: 我试着同时处理几项任务时，就会注意力不集中。

entries.en: The cat stared unblinkingly at the moth on the window.
entries.zh: 那只猫一眨不眨地盯着窗上的飞蛾。

entries.en: The audience was unappreciative of the delicate music and talked throughout.
entries.zh: 观众并不欣赏这段细腻的音乐，一直在说话。

entries.en: An unnameable feeling kept her awake long after the house grew quiet.
entries.zh: 屋子安静下来很久以后，一种难以形容的感觉仍让她无法入睡。

entries.en: Being quiet does not mean that someone is unintelligent.
entries.zh: 一个人安静，并不意味着这个人缺乏才智。

entries.en: She would not call a beginner untalented after just one lesson.
entries.zh: 她不会仅凭一堂课就说一个初学者没有天赋。

entries.en: The report lists nonperformance of the agreed duties as the main complaint.
entries.zh: 报告把未履行约定职责列为主要投诉事项。

entries.en: The server sends a confirmation message to the requester.
entries.zh: 服务器向请求方发送一条确认消息。

entries.en: The tree traversal stopped when it reached the marked node.
entries.zh: 这次树遍历在到达标记节点时停止了。

entries.en: The undistributed leaflets were still stacked beside the door.
entries.zh: 尚未分发的传单仍然堆在门旁。

entries.en: The lid would not close on the overfull bin.
entries.zh: 这个垃圾桶装得太满，盖子合不上。

entries.en: She repairs bicycles on the side while studying engineering.
entries.zh: 她一边读工程专业，一边兼职修自行车。

entries.en: Save the draft now, or else your changes may be lost.
entries.zh: 现在就保存草稿，否则你的修改可能会丢失。

entries.en: He invented the excuse out of thin air when the teacher asked.
entries.zh: 老师问起时，他凭空编造了这个借口。

entries.en: Everyone can pitch in to clear the hall after the concert.
entries.zh: 音乐会结束后，大家都可以一起动手清理大厅。

entries.en: The children like to play around in the garden before dinner.
entries.zh: 孩子们喜欢在晚饭前在花园里玩耍。

entries.en: The young runner became a poster child for the club's successful training programme.
entries.zh: 这名年轻跑步运动员成了俱乐部成功训练计划的代表人物。

entries.en: Unexpected demand persuaded the publisher to increase the book's print run.
entries.zh: 出乎意料的需求促使出版商增加这本书的印数。

entries.en: The museum is managed by a private enterprise rather than the city council.
entries.zh: 这家博物馆由一家民营企业管理，而不是由市议会管理。

entries.en: The insect bite started to puff up her hand.
entries.zh: 蚊虫叮咬开始让她的手肿起来。

entries.en: The neighbours had to pull together after the storm damaged their street.
entries.zh: 暴风雨破坏了这条街后，邻居们不得不齐心协力。

entries.en: Please rake up the fallen leaves before the rain starts.
entries.zh: 请在开始下雨前把落叶耙到一起。

entries.en: The clerk wrote the rate of exchange on the receipt.
entries.zh: 柜员把兑换率写在了收据上。

entries.en: A remote-controlled boat carried the small camera across the pond.
entries.zh: 一艘遥控船载着那台小摄像机驶过池塘。

entries.en: The rooted cuttings were ready to be moved into larger pots.
entries.zh: 已经生根的插条可以移栽到更大的花盆里了。

entries.en: You can run along now; I will finish locking the classroom.
entries.zh: 你现在可以走了；我来把教室锁好。

entries.en: After a week of late shifts, he felt tired and run-down.
entries.zh: 值了一周晚班后，他觉得很累，精疲力尽。

entries.en: We compared the running time of both sorting programs on identical files.
entries.zh: 我们比较了两个排序程序处理相同文件时的运行时间。

entries.en: After winning every practice match, she looked like a shoo-in for captain.
entries.zh: 练习赛场场获胜后，她看来几乎肯定会当选队长。

entries.en: The signing of the lease took place in a small office upstairs.
entries.zh: 租约的签署是在楼上一间小办公室进行的。

entries.en: He waited for the noise to rise so he could slip in unnoticed.
entries.zh: 他等声音大起来，好趁机悄悄溜进去而不被发现。

entries.en: My coat was soaked after I walked home without an umbrella.
entries.zh: 我没带伞步行回家后，外套湿透了。

entries.en: The sign warned drivers that speeding would be reported to the police.
entries.zh: 路牌警告司机，超速行驶会被举报给警方。

entries.meaningZh: 摆出自卫或攻击的架势
entries.en: The two boxers began to square off as the bell rang.
entries.zh: 铃声响起时，两名拳击手开始摆出交战的架势。

entries.en: Small expenses can stack up to a surprisingly large bill.
entries.zh: 小额支出加起来，也可能形成一笔惊人的大账单。

entries.en: Her hand rested on the stick shift while the car was stationary.
entries.zh: 汽车停着时，她的手放在变速杆上。

entries.en: Gentle irony was the columnist's stock-in-trade, not angry insults.
entries.zh: 这位专栏作家的惯用手段是温和的反讽，而不是愤怒的辱骂。

entries.en: She felt stressed as three deadlines approached in the same week.
entries.zh: 同一周里有三个截止日期临近，她感到压力很大。

entries.en: Please sweep up the paper scraps before the next group arrives.
entries.zh: 请在下一组人到来前把纸屑扫干净。

entries.en: You can take it easy; we still have an hour before the train leaves.
entries.zh: 你可以从容一点；离火车发车还有一个小时。

entries.en: The child tried to tear apart the cardboard box with bare hands.
entries.zh: 这个孩子试图徒手把纸箱撕开。

entries.en: To begin with, we need a clear map of the existing system.
entries.zh: 首先，我们需要一张清楚展示现有系统的图。

entries.en: He is tone-deaf and cannot tell whether the second note is higher.
entries.zh: 他是音盲，分辨不出第二个音是否更高。

entries.en: We slept under canvas beside the lake for three nights.
entries.zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里睡了三个晚上。

entries.en: The crowd watched the conductor's uplifted hands before the music began.
entries.zh: 音乐开始前，人群注视着指挥举起的双手。

entries.en: The members agreed to vote out the chair at the next election.
entries.zh: 成员们同意在下次选举中把主席选下台。

entries.en: The child seemed well-adjusted and made friends easily at her new school.
entries.zh: 这个孩子看来适应得很好，在新学校很容易就交到了朋友。

entries.en: This is without doubt the clearest explanation in the entire report.
entries.zh: 毫无疑问，这是整份报告中最清楚的解释。

entries.en: The committee rejected the wishy-washy proposal because it contained no clear commitments.
entries.zh: 委员会否决了这项空泛的提案，因为其中没有明确的承诺。

entries.en: The prime minister answered questions about the education budget.
entries.zh: 首相回答了有关教育预算的问题。

entries.en: Put the story's events in their natural order before writing the summary.
entries.zh: 写摘要前，先把故事中的事件按自然顺序排列。

entries.en: The software flags nonuniformity in the spacing between table columns.
entries.zh: 该软件会标记表格列间距不一致的情况。

entries.en: She checked whether the vector belonged to the matrix's null space.
entries.zh: 她检查这个向量是否属于该矩阵的零空间。

entries.en: The parser rejected the last character because it was not an octal digit.
entries.zh: 解析器拒绝了最后一个字符，因为它不是八进制数字。

entries.en: We formed pairs, leaving Leo as the odd man out.
entries.zh: 我们两两配对，结果剩下利奥一个人。

entries.en: This drawer holds my one and only copy of the letter.
entries.zh: 这个抽屉里放着我唯一的一份信件副本。

entries.en: I want to paint a picture of the harbour at sunset.
entries.zh: 我想画一幅港口日落时的画。

entries.en: She made a hot pepper sauce from the red chillies in her garden.
entries.zh: 她用自家花园里的红辣椒做了一种辣椒酱。

entries.en: The difference between the two reported rates was one percentage point.
entries.zh: 报告中的两个比率相差一个百分点。

entries.en: The course compares the political system of each country through case studies.
entries.zh: 这门课通过案例研究比较各个国家的政治制度。

entries.en: We served the pork roast with potatoes and a sharp apple sauce.
entries.zh: 我们把烤猪肉配上土豆和酸味的苹果酱端上桌。

entries.en: Rain continued to pour down while we waited beneath the station roof.
entries.zh: 我们在车站顶棚下等候时，雨还在倾盆而下。

entries.en: Smoke continued to pour forth from the damaged chimney.
entries.zh: 烟不断从受损的烟囱中涌出。

entries.en: Demand for the magazine justified a larger press run next month.
entries.zh: 这份杂志的需求量足以支持下个月采用更大的印数。

entries.en: She fried a rasher of smoked bacon for breakfast.
entries.zh: 她煎了一片熏肉当早餐。

entries.en: She deleted a nonsignificant detail that distracted readers from the main argument.
entries.zh: 她删去了一个分散读者对主要论点注意力的无足轻重的细节。

entries.en: High delivery costs made the shop's prices uncompetitive.
entries.zh: 高昂的配送成本使这家商店的价格缺乏竞争力。

entries.en: They chose an unfrequented path along the edge of the forest.
entries.zh: 他们选择了一条沿着森林边缘、人迹罕至的小路。

entries.en: The old chapel contained a stone sepulchre covered in weathered carvings.
entries.zh: 旧礼拜堂里有一座石墓，上面布满了风化的雕刻。

entries.en: Please bring the spare cable pronto; the presentation starts in minutes.
entries.zh: 请马上把备用线缆拿来；演示几分钟后就开始了。

entries.en: I offered to pay for the tickets if he arranged the transport.
entries.zh: 我提出，如果他安排交通，我就支付票款。

entries.en: Printing stopped when the paper feed became uneven.
entries.zh: 进纸不均匀时，打印停止了。

entries.en: For one moment, the entire room fell silent.
entries.zh: 有那么一会儿，整个房间都安静了下来。

entries.en: An old lady stood beside the gate, holding a red umbrella.
entries.zh: 一位老太太拿着一把红伞站在门旁。

entries.en: We were pressed for time and had to shorten the discussion.
entries.zh: 我们时间紧迫，只好缩短讨论。

entries.en: She wrapped the vegetables in softened rice paper.
entries.zh: 她用软化的米纸把蔬菜包了起来。

entries.en: Her leather personal organizer was filled with handwritten appointments.
entries.zh: 她那本皮面个人备忘记事本上写满了手写的预约事项。

entries.en: The app paused location tracking when the battery ran low.
entries.zh: 该应用在电量不足时暂停了位置跟踪。

entries.en: It had been a shattering day, with meetings from dawn until late evening.
entries.zh: 那是令人极度疲劳的一天，会议从黎明一直持续到晚间。
